description: Enable extended reasoning capabilities for Anthropic models in the Copilot chat interface. This feature should allow Anthropic models to show their thinking process when generating responses, similar to how other AI assistants display reasoning steps. The implementation should add the necessary headers and properties to support this functionality.
functional_requirements: Add support for extended reasoning headers when making requests to Anthropic models through Copilot
Configure the Anthropic provider to include thinking mode parameters in API calls
Update the Copilot chat interface to properly display reasoning steps when using Anthropic models
Ensure the feature works with the existing Copilot chat response handling system
Add appropriate configuration options to control extended reasoning behavior
Maintain backward compatibility with existing Anthropic model usage patterns
